J1.evidence: Source quotes al-Zamakhshari: «نطفة أمشاج كبرمة أعشار وبرد أكباش». A gloss translating a quoted phrase is acceptable in itself, but EN «برد أكباش (a garment of coarse yarn)» renders the meaning of al-Kashshaf's «برد أكياش» (twice-spun yarn), not the word printed here (أكباش = rams). That silently corrects the source / translates a different text, with no [Translator's note: …] (TR flags exactly this in a Mütercim notu). Fix: add a Translator's note that the source prints «أكباش», the Kashshaf reading being «أكياش». Rest of EN (incl. notes on وزقت, the cup/spring pronoun, الثلث الباقي) checked and faithful.

J2.evidence: Source (quoting al-Zamakhsharī): نطفة أمشاج كبرمة أعشار وبرد أكباش. EN renders 'برد أكباش (a garment of coarse yarn)' — 'coarse yarn' is the meaning of أكياش (the Kashshāf reading), not of the printed أكباش ('rams'); EN thus silently translates a different text with no Translator's note, whereas TR flags «[Mütercim notu: el-Keşşâf'ta bilinen ifade «برد أكياش»tır; kaynakta «أكباش» yazılıdır.]». Fix: add the equivalent Translator's note (or mark the gloss as the translator's).
